name: Neulogy Ventures
decision_note: Bratislava early-stage deeptech VC (Luxembourg SICAR, EIF investment period to 14 March 2027, so not E7), but its latest dated deal is the StratifAI pre-seed of 2024-09-02, before the window; no deal or fund close dated on/after 2024-10-25 was found - unverified.

evidence.quote: Neulogy Ventures was established in 2014 as a Luxembourg-based regulated venture capital fund, targeting investment opportunities in early-stage tech companies established or operating in Slovakia.

With €65M assets under management, about 30 portfolio companies spread across 10 countries, and a strong track record investing in new technologies addressing climate change and healthcare, Neulogy Ventures is one of the leading deeptech investors in the CEE region.
Moonshot ideas pushing the frontier in technology, climate and health.

Our investors include 40+ key players in the local entrepreneurial ecosystem, joined by the European Investment Fund (EIF), the Slovak Investment Holding (SIH) and Tatra banka (RBI Group) as institutional investors.

As a financial market participant, Neulogy Ventures S.à r.l as general partner and registered alternative investment fund manager of Slovak Venture Fund S.C.A., SICAR (the “SICAR”) makes the following disclosure in accordance with SFDR.
Slovak Venture Fund S.C.A., SICAR Neulogy Ventures a.s. Slovakia CEFoF;EGF Slovakia Venture Capital ICT Balanced Fund 14/03/2027
Geography SMEs established or operating in Slovakia
The fund's investment period ran from 2014 to 2016.
StratifAI GmbH Sep 2024 Pre Seed Lead
Early Funding Sep 30, 2025 Pre Seed Sep 2, 2024
In the case of GreenWay, Mirova is joining existing shareholders Janom Investment, Generation Capital, Helios Energy Investment Funds and Neulogy Ventures.

analyst_notes: Activity (I3): Neulogy's own portfolio page gives only the year for StratifAI ('Invested: 2025'); date set to 2025-01-01 as a year-only placeholder (any 2025 date is inside the window). Conflict: aggregator pages (Signalbase, published 2024-09-02) report StratifAI's EUR 1.5m pre-seed co-led by Neulogy Ventures and MultiplexDX in Sept 2024, i.e. before the window; Neulogy's 2025 date may be the closing or a follow-on (StratifAI raised EUR 12.5m in Sept 2025 with 'existing investors', Neulogy not named in the coverage I opened). Supporting signal: the EIF list 'EIF equity fund partners as at 30 September 2026' (e9, published_on null; 'as at' date 2026-09-30) shows Slovak Venture Fund S.C.A., SICAR (mandates CEFoF and EGF) with end of investment period 14/03/2027, i.e. an open investment period; SIH's page (e12) refers only to the 2014-2016 JEREMIE compartments, now divesting. CB Insights (JS/paywalled, not cited) lists GA Drilling Series D 2025-07-31 for Neulogy; GA Drilling's own March 2026 release and ThinkGeoEnergy (2026-03-03) do not name Neulogy, so not used. BeIT and BiteBerry are dated only '2024' on Neulogy's site (BiteBerry round reported 2024-09-10 by CB Insights, before the window). Ticket: own site EUR 200k-3m (newest B) vs SLOVCA self-reported 200,000-2.5M. Capital: EUR 65m AUM from the undated about-us page (as_of unknown, null); aggregators show 36m/70m. Sector: own site 'technology, climate and health' + deeptech; EIF lists main sector ICT. Geography: invests in companies established or operating in Slovakia, but portfolio spans 10 countries (StratifAI is Berlin/Dresden). Legal: Slovak company Neulogy Ventures, a. s. (IČO 47367610, ORSR Sa 5826/B, board Christian Mandl, Jaroslav Luptak, Martin Smetana) is named by EIF as fund manager; the Luxembourg GP/registered AIFM is Neulogy Ventures S.à r.l. (CSSF-regulated; LU registry id not checked). Not on the NBS register. Discovered via: SLOVCA full member; SIH intermediary page; EIF fund-partner list; Jaroslav Ľupták (Partner, Neulogy Ventures) quoted in Startup Report Slovensko 2025; Papermark Bratislava VC list (news). Web-search budget ran out during research; Slovak press for 2025-2026 Neulogy deals was not exhaustively searched. [revision 2026-10-25 after review: decision include -> unverified (E8). The StratifAI date 2025-01-01 was a placeholder built from the portfolio label 'Invested: 2025' (e6); the dated record is the pre-seed led by Neulogy on 2024-09-02 (Caplight: 'Sep 2024 Pre Seed Lead' on the Neulogy profile, e13, and 'Pre Seed Sep 2, 2024' on the StratifAI profile, e14), i.e. before the window; StratifAI's next round (2025-09-30) lists Alven, Picus, Heliad and Arve, not Neulogy. Looked once more: the Neulogy site (portfolio years 2023 or earlier, BeIT/BiteBerry 2024, news page) and web search found no 2025-2026 deal or fund close. Caplight also lists 'GreenWay Mar 2025 Growth Equity Co-investor', but the primary coverage of that round (electrive 2025-03-17, e15) names Neulogy only as an existing shareholder joined by Mirova, so it is not counted as a new investment. The EIF list (e9) shows the fund's investment period running to 14/03/2027, so the fund is not a zombie (not E7), but an open investment period is not itself a dated I3 event. Re-screen when a dated 2024-10-25+ deal appears.]
